original_question: Mai aikin kwaliya na Jean na cajin ta $250 a awa daya. Tana bukatar makeup mai tsada sosai ga fim din da take ciki kuma tana daukar awa 6 tana yin sa a kowace rana kuma tana bukatar ayi sau 4 a sati. Fim ɗin yana ɗaukar makonni 5 don kammalawa. Bayan an gama fim ɗin mai kwalliyar ya ba Jean rangwame 10% saboda yawan aikin da aka yi. Nawa Jean ta biya?
